# Owned country lookup fixture

`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` and `GeoIP2-ISP-Test.mmdb` are synthetic test data copied verbatim from
`mori://maxmind/MaxMind-DB` at commit `0ee49278e35fd7bdf341ac236edbba20de1aceb9`,
project-relative paths `test-data/GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` and `test-data/GeoIP2-ISP-Test.mmdb` (artifact-level URI pending).
Copyright (c) 2013–2026 MaxMind, Inc.; used under its MIT option, reproduced in
`LICENSE-MIT`. The fixture contains no production address observations.

Tests use the maintained `mori://maxmind/libmaxminddb` reader, released 1.14.1.
